meaning:
ὑπο-τύπωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑποτυπόω, to delineate),
an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, a pattern, example: 1Ti.1:16, 2Ti.1:13.†
SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see DB, iii, 696b) (AS)

elsewhere.note: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in…
Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
